info.title: Dragon Math API
info.description: The routes the Dragon Academy iOS app uses. Generated from server/contracts/ by `npm run openapi`; do not edit by hand.

match_id.description: The id the device minted for this match; match_started and match_ended share it.

SyncMatchStartedPayload.description: kind `match_started`. occurred_at is when the battle began.

match_id.description: The id the device minted for this match; match_started and match_ended share it.

SyncMatchEndedPayload.description: kind `match_ended`. occurred_at is when it resolved. A finished match keeps its result, except that a real result replaces `incomplete`.

node_id.description: Story node, or 0 for practice games.

outcome.description: Who got the problem: the kid, or the opponent.

time_ms.description: How long the answer took, in milliseconds.
How long the answer took, in milliseconds.

SyncWrongTapPayload.description: kind `wrong_tap`: a wrong answer the kid tapped.

SyncNodeWonPayload.description: kind `node_won`. The best stars and the first completion are kept, in whatever order wins arrive.

dragon_ids.description: Dragons won; repeat an id to award it twice. Ids not in the catalog are skipped.

minutes.description: Consecutive active minutes starting at occurred_at.

SyncPlaytimePayload.description: kind `playtime`: minutes the kid was actively playing.

effective_plan.description: Highest plan among the child's guardians: free, premium or classroom.

family_mode.description: Present and true when the session came from a shared family device.

games_locked.description: Game ids (src/data/games.js) the child cannot open on their plan.

email.description: The login email. For a Sign in with Apple account it may be a private relay address.

contact_email.description: Where progress digests and COPPA notices go. Null until the parent sets one.

error.description: Human-readable message, safe to show a kid or parent.

token.description: JWT for the Authorization: Bearer header. Valid for 30 days.
The login token from a /k/<token> link or QR code.

child_id.description: Id of a child linked to the family.

token.description: The family token from a family-device link.

child_id.description: Id of a child linked to the family.

identity_token.description: The identityToken from ASAuthorizationAppleIDCredential, as a string.

nonce.description: The RAW nonce. The authorization request must have carried its SHA-256 as lowercase hex; the server checks the token's nonce claim against that hash.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: At least one field is required.

schema_version.description: Shape of this document. Bumped only for a breaking change; new sections and fields are not breaking.

version.description: Hash of the content. Changes whenever any value does; compare to a cached copy.

grid_size.description: Battle grid is grid_size × grid_size cells (2–10).

ops.description: Operations this node draws problems from: add, sub, mul, div.

ai_seconds.description: The opponent's base seconds per solve on this node.

shape_id.description: Grid shape id, or null for a plain square grid.

jitter_fraction.description: Solve delay is ai_seconds × 1000 jittered by ±(jitter_fraction / 2).

min_delay_ms.description: The opponent never solves faster than this.

grid_blank_ms.description: Grid blank time after the child solves a problem.

grid_blank_ai_ms.description: Grid blank time after the opponent solves one.

grid_lock_ms.description: How long a wrong tap locks the grid.

wrong_flash_ms.description: How long the tapped wrong cell flashes.

catalog.description: Every non-retired dragon, in dragon_id order.

total_dragons.description: Length of catalog, for the "X / total collected" headline.

count.description: How many of this dragon the child has caught.

first_acquired_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the first catch.

name.description: Null when the dragon is not in the catalog.

rarity.description: common, uncommon, rare, very_rare, legendary or mythic.
common, uncommon, rare, very_rare, legendary or mythic.

dragons.description: Every non-retired dragon, in dragon_id order.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp. Changes on every edit.

created_by_self.description: True when the caller made the list (false: "added by a grown-up").

words.description: Lower-case words, in the order the list was typed.

audio_missing.description: Words with no recorded clip; their audio URL 404s.

example_sentences.description: Word → a sentence using it, for the words that have one.

category.description: What kind of text it is, verse, poem, quote, speech, definition or other.

body.description: The text to learn, exactly as the grown-up entered it.

mastery_level.description: Hardest level practised: 0 none, 1 easy, 2 medium, 3 hard.

last_practiced_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp, or null if never practised.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last edit; identifies the revision a practice session was of.

results.description: One per event, in request order.

index.description: Position of the event in the request.

id.description: The event id as sent, or null when it had none.

status.description: applied (written), stored (kept, kind not applied yet), duplicate (already received), rejected (will never be accepted; see reason), failed (server error; resend later). A string rather than an enum so a new status cannot break an older app — act on `acknowledged`.

acknowledged.description: True when the server is done with this event and the device may delete it. Only `failed` is false.

reason.description: For rejected and failed: a stable code (invalid_event, invalid_payload, not_your_child, id_conflict, not_your_match, unknown_dragons, invalid_data, server_error).

message.description: For rejected and failed: human-readable detail.

SyncEventsRequest.description: 1–100 events, oldest first by convention; any order is accepted.

id.description: Minted on the device; the dedupe key. Never reuse one.

child_id.description: Whose event this is. A kid session may only send its own id; a grown-up, a linked child.

kind.description: One of match_started, match_ended, attempt, wrong_tap, node_won, dragons_collected, playtime; any other kind is stored but not applied.

occurred_at.description: When it happened on the device. A time in the future is recorded as now.

payload.description: The kind-specific fields — see the Sync*Payload schemas.

plan.description: The plan in effect: free, premium or classroom. Highest grant wins.

source.description: Where the grant comes from: stripe, app_store, comp, manual or classroom. Null on free.

grants.description: Every paid grant in effect, best first. For a child, those of all their guardians.

app_account_token.description: UUID to pass as StoreKit's appAccountToken when this parent buys, so the App Store subscription is credited to this account. Null for kids.

source.description: Where the grant comes from: stripe, app_store, comp, manual or classroom.

expires_at.description: When the grant ends or next renews; null when it does not expire.

will_renew.description: Whether it renews at expires_at; null when unknown or not applicable.

games_locked.description: Game ids (src/data/games.js) locked on this plan.

child_limit.description: Children an adult on this plan may have; null = unlimited.
